<section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id2440627f-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841"><num value="841">§ 841.</num><heading> Prohibited acts A</heading><subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id24406280-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/a"><num value="a" class="bold">(a)</num><heading class="bold"> Unlawful acts</heading><chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Except as authorized by this subchapter, it shall be unlawful for any person knowingly or intentionally—</chapeau><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406281-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/a/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><content> to manufacture, distribute, or dispense, or possess with intent to manufacture, distribute, or dispense, a controlled substance; or</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406282-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/a/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><content> to create, distribute, or dispense, or possess with intent to distribute or dispense, a counterfeit substance.</content>
</paragraph>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id24406283-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b"><num value="b" class="bold">(b)</num><heading class="bold"> Penalties</heading><chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Except as otherwise provided in section 849, 859, 860, or 861 of this title, any person who violates subsection (a) of this section shall be sentenced as follows:</chapeau><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id24406284-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id24406285-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><chapeau> In the case of a violation of subsection (a) of this section involving—</chapeau><clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406286-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> 1 kilogram or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of heroin;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406287-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><chapeau> 5 kilograms or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of—</chapeau><subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24406288-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/ii/I"><num value="I">(I)</num><content> coca leaves, except coca leaves and extracts of coca leaves from which cocaine, ecgonine, and derivatives of ecgonine or their salts have been removed;</content>
</subclause>
<subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24406289-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/ii/II"><num value="II">(II)</num><content> cocaine, its salts, optical and geometric isomers, and salts of isomers;</content>
</subclause>
<subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2440628a-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/ii/III"><num value="III">(III)</num><content> ecgonine, its derivatives, their salts, isomers, and salts of isomers; or</content>
</subclause>
<subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2440628b-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/ii/IV"><num value="IV">(IV)</num><content> any compound, mixture, or preparation which contains any quantity of any of the substances referred to in subclauses (I) through (III);</content>
</subclause>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440628c-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><content> 280 grams or more of a mixture or substance described in clause (ii) which contains cocaine base;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440628d-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/iv"><num value="iv">(iv)</num><content> 100 grams or more of phencyclidine (PCP) or 1 kilogram or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of phencyclidine (PCP);</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440628e-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/v"><num value="v">(v)</num><content> 10 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD);</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440628f-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/vi"><num value="vi">(vi)</num><content> 400 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of N-phenyl-N- [ 1- ( 2-phenylethyl ) -4-piperidinyl ] propanamide or 100 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of any analogue of N-phenyl-N-[1-(2-phenylethyl)-4-piperidinyl] propanamide;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406290-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/vii"><num value="vii">(vii)</num><content> 1000 kilograms or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of marihuana, or 1,000 or more marihuana plants regardless of weight; or</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406291-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/A/viii"><num value="viii">(viii)</num><content> 50 grams or more of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, and salts of its isomers or 500 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, or salts of its isomers;</content>
</clause>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment which may not be less than 10 years or more than life and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be not less than 20 years or more than life, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $10,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $50,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a serious drug felony or serious violent felony has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 15 years and not more than life imprisonment and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to life imprisonment, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $20,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $75,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits a violation of this subparagraph or of section 849, 859, 860, or 861 of this title after 2 or more prior convictions for a serious drug felony or serious violent felony have become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 25 years and fined in accordance with the preceding sentence. Notwithstanding <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3583">section 3583 of title 18</ref>, any sentence under this subparagraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 5 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 10 years in addition to such term of imprisonment. Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the court shall not place on probation or suspend the sentence of any person sentenced under this subparagraph. No person sentenced under this subparagraph shall be eligible for parole during the term of imprisonment imposed therein.</continuation>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id24406292-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><chapeau> In the case of a violation of subsection (a) of this section involving—</chapeau><clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406293-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> 100 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of heroin;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406294-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><chapeau> 500 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of—</chapeau><subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24406295-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/ii/I"><num value="I">(I)</num><content> coca leaves, except coca leaves and extracts of coca leaves from which cocaine, ecgonine, and derivatives of ecgonine or their salts have been removed;</content>
</subclause>
<subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24406296-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/ii/II"><num value="II">(II)</num><content> cocaine, its salts, optical and geometric isomers, and salts of isomers;</content>
</subclause>
<subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24406297-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/ii/III"><num value="III">(III)</num><content> ecgonine, its derivatives, their salts, isomers, and salts of isomers; or</content>
</subclause>
<subclause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24406298-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/ii/IV"><num value="IV">(IV)</num><content> any compound, mixture, or preparation which contains any quantity of any of the substances referred to in subclauses (I) through (III);</content>
</subclause>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24406299-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><content> 28 grams or more of a mixture or substance described in clause (ii) which contains cocaine base;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440629a-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/iv"><num value="iv">(iv)</num><content> 10 grams or more of phencyclidine (PCP) or 100 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of phencyclidine (PCP);</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440629b-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/v"><num value="v">(v)</num><content> 1 gram or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD);</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440629c-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/vi"><num value="vi">(vi)</num><content> 40 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of N-phenyl-N- [ 1- ( 2-phenylethyl ) -4-piperidinyl ] propanamide or 10 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of any analogue of N-phenyl-N-[1-(2-phenylethyl)-4-piperidinyl] propanamide;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440629d-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/vii"><num value="vii">(vii)</num><content> 100 kilograms or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of marihuana, or 100 or more marihuana plants regardless of weight; or</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2440629e-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/B/viii"><num value="viii">(viii)</num><content> 5 grams or more of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, and salts of its isomers or 50 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, or salts of its isomers;</content>
</clause>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment which may not be less than 5 years and not more than 40 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be not less than 20 years or more than life, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $5,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $25,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a serious drug felony or serious violent felony has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment which may not be less than 10 years and not more than life imprisonment and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to life imprisonment, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $8,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $50,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Notwithstanding <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3583">section 3583 of title 18</ref>, any sentence imposed under this subparagraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, include a term of supervised release of at least 4 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, include a term of supervised release of at least 8 years in addition to such term of imprisonment. Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the court shall not place on probation or suspend the sentence of any person sentenced under this subparagraph. No person sentenced under this subparagraph shall be eligible for parole during the term of imprisonment imposed therein.</continuation>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2440629f-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/C"><num value="C">(C)</num><content> In the case of a controlled substance in schedule I or II, gamma hydroxybutyric acid (including when scheduled as an approved drug product for purposes of section 3(a)(1)(B) of the Hillory J. Farias and Samantha Reid Date-Rape Drug Prohibition Act of 2000), or 1 gram of flunitrazepam, except as provided in subparagraphs (A), (B), and (D), such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 20 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than twenty years or more than life, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $1,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $5,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a felony drug offense has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 30 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to life imprisonment, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $2,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $10,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Notwithstanding <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3583">section 3583 of title 18</ref>, any sentence imposing a term of imprisonment under this paragraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 3 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 6 years in addition to such term of imprisonment. Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the court shall not place on probation or suspend the sentence of any person sentenced under the provisions of this subparagraph which provide for a mandatory term of imprisonment if death or serious bodily injury results, nor shall a person so sentenced be eligible for parole during the term of such a sentence.</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a0-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/D"><num value="D">(D)</num><content> In the case of less than 50 kilograms of marihuana, except in the case of 50 or more marihuana plants regardless of weight, 10 kilograms of hashish, or one kilogram of hashish oil, such person shall, except as provided in paragraphs (4) and (5) of this subsection, be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 5 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $250,000 if the defendant is an individual or $1,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a felony drug offense has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 10 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $500,000 if the defendant is an individual or $2,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Notwithstanding <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3583">section 3583 of title 18</ref>, any sentence imposing a term of imprisonment under this paragraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 2 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 4 years in addition to such term of imprisonment.</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a1-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/E"><num value="E">(E)</num><clause style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a2-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/E/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> Except as provided in subparagraphs (C) and (D), in the case of any controlled substance in schedule III, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 10 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 15 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $500,000 if the defendant is an individual or $2,500,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both.</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a3-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/E/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><content> If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a felony drug offense has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 20 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 30 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $1,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $5,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both.</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a4-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/E/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><content> Any sentence imposing a term of imprisonment under this subparagraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 2 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 4 years in addition to such term of imprisonment.</content>
</clause>
</subparagraph>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a5-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><content> In the case of a controlled substance in schedule IV, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 5 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $250,000 if the defendant is an individual or $1,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a felony drug offense has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 10 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $500,000 if the defendant is an individual or $2,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Any sentence imposing a term of imprisonment under this paragraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least one year in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 2 years in addition to such term of imprisonment.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a6-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/3"><num value="3">(3)</num><content> In the case of a controlled substance in schedule V, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than one year, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $100,000 if the defendant is an individual or $250,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a felony drug offense has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 4 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $200,000 if the defendant is an individual or $500,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Any sentence imposing a term of imprisonment under this paragraph may, if there was a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of not more than 1 year, in addition to such term of imprisonment.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a7-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/4"><num value="4">(4)</num><content> Notwithstanding paragraph (1)(D) of this subsection, any person who violates subsection (a) of this section by distributing a small amount of marihuana for no remuneration shall be treated as provided in <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s844">section 844 of this title</ref> and <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3607">section 3607 of title 18</ref>.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062a8-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/5"><num value="5">(5)</num><chapeau> Any person who violates subsection (a) of this section by cultivating or manufacturing a controlled substance on Federal property shall be imprisoned as provided in this subsection and shall be fined any amount not to exceed—</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id244062a9-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/5/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><content> the amount authorized in accordance with this section;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id244062aa-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/5/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><content> the amount authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id244062ab-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/5/C"><num value="C">(C)</num><content> $500,000 if the defendant is an individual; or</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id244062ac-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/5/D"><num value="D">(D)</num><content> $1,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual;</content>
</subparagraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">or both.</continuation>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id244062ad-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/6"><num value="6">(6)</num><chapeau> Any person who violates subsection (a), or attempts to do so, and knowingly or intentionally uses a poison, chemical, or other hazardous substance on Federal land, and, by such use—</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id244062ae-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/6/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><content> creates a serious hazard to humans, wildlife, or domestic animals,</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id244062af-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/6/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><content> degrades or harms the environment or natural resources, or</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id244062b0-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/6/C"><num value="C">(C)</num><content> pollutes an aquifer, spring, stream, river, or body of water,</content>
</subparagraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">shall be fined in accordance with title 18 or imprisoned not more than five years, or both.</continuation>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442aba1-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/7"><num value="7">(7)</num><heading> <inline class="small-caps">Penalties for distribution.—</inline></heading><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442aba2-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/7/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><heading> <inline class="small-caps">In general</inline>.—</heading><content>Whoever, with intent to commit a crime of violence, as defined in <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s16">section 16 of title 18</ref> (including rape), against an individual, violates subsection (a) by distributing a controlled substance or controlled substance analogue to that individual without that individual’s knowledge, shall be imprisoned not more than 20 years and fined in accordance with title 18.</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442aba3-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/7/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><heading> <inline class="small-caps">Definition</inline>.—</heading><content>For purposes of this paragraph, the term “without that individual’s knowledge” means that the individual is unaware that a substance with the ability to alter that individual’s ability to appraise conduct or to decline participation in or communicate unwillingness to participate in conduct is administered to the individual.</content>
</subparagraph>
</paragraph>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2442aba4-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/c"><num value="c" class="bold">(c)</num><heading class="bold"> Offenses involving listed chemicals</heading><chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Any person who knowingly or intentionally—</chapeau><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442aba5-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/c/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><content> possesses a listed chemical with intent to manufacture a controlled substance except as authorized by this subchapter;</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442aba6-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/c/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><content> possesses or distributes a listed chemical knowing, or having reasonable cause to believe, that the listed chemical will be used to manufacture a controlled substance except as authorized by this subchapter; or</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442aba7-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/c/3"><num value="3">(3)</num><content> with the intent of causing the evasion of the recordkeeping or reporting requirements of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s830">section 830 of this title</ref>, or the regulations issued under that section, receives or distributes a reportable amount of any listed chemical in units small enough so that the making of records or filing of reports under that section is not required;</content>
</paragraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">shall be fined in accordance with title 18 or imprisoned not more than 20 years in the case of a violation of paragraph (1) or (2) involving a list I chemical or not more than 10 years in the case of a violation of this subsection other than a violation of paragraph (1) or (2) involving a list I chemical, or both.</continuation>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2442aba8-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/d"><num value="d" class="bold">(d)</num><heading class="bold"> Boobytraps on Federal property; penalties; “boobytrap” defined</heading><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442aba9-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/d/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><content> Any person who assembles, maintains, places, or causes to be placed a boobytrap on Federal property where a controlled substance is being manufactured, distributed, or dispensed shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment for not more than 10 years or fined under title 18, or both.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442abaa-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/d/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><content> If any person commits such a violation after 1 or more prior convictions for an offense punishable under this subsection, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 20 years or fined under title 18, or both.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442abab-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/d/3"><num value="3">(3)</num><content> For the purposes of this subsection, the term “boobytrap” means any concealed or camouflaged device designed to cause bodily injury when triggered by any action of any unsuspecting person making contact with the device. Such term includes guns, ammunition, or explosive devices attached to trip wires or other triggering mechanisms, sharpened stakes, and lines or wires with hooks attached.</content>
</paragraph>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abac-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/e"><num value="e" class="bold">(e)</num><heading class="bold"> Ten-year injunction as additional penalty</heading><content><p style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">In addition to any other applicable penalty, any person convicted of a felony violation of this section relating to the receipt, distribution, manufacture, exportation, or importation of a listed chemical may be enjoined from engaging in any transaction involving a listed chemical for not more than ten years.</p>
</content>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abad-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/f"><num value="f" class="bold">(f)</num><heading class="bold"> Wrongful distribution or possession of listed chemicals</heading><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442abae-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/f/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><content> Whoever knowingly distributes a listed chemical in violation of this subchapter (other than in violation of a recordkeeping or reporting requirement of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s830">section 830 of this title</ref>) shall, except to the extent that paragraph (12), (13), or (14) of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s842/a">section 842(a) of this title</ref> applies, be fined under title 18 or imprisoned not more than 5 years, or both.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442abaf-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/f/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><content> Whoever possesses any listed chemical, with knowledge that the recordkeeping or reporting requirements of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s830">section 830 of this title</ref> have not been adhered to, if, after such knowledge is acquired, such person does not take immediate steps to remedy the violation shall be fined under title 18 or imprisoned not more than one year, or both.</content>
</paragraph>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abb0-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g"><num value="g" class="bold">(g)</num><heading class="bold"> Internet sales of date rape drugs</heading><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442abb1-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><chapeau> Whoever knowingly uses the Internet to distribute a date rape drug to any person, knowing or with reasonable cause to believe that—</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442abb2-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/1/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><content> the drug would be used in the commission of criminal sexual conduct; or</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442abb3-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/1/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><content> the person is not an authorized purchaser;</content>
</subparagraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">shall be fined under this subchapter or imprisoned not more than 20 years, or both.</continuation>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442abb4-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><chapeau> As used in this subsection:</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442abb5-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><chapeau> The term “date rape drug” means—</chapeau><clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abb6-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/A/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> gamma hydroxybutyric acid (GHB) or any controlled substance analogue of GHB, including gamma butyrolactone (GBL) or 1,4–butanediol;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abb7-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/A/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><content> ketamine;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abb8-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/A/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><content> flunitrazepam; or</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abb9-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/A/iv"><num value="iv">(iv)</num><content> any substance which the Attorney General designates, pursuant to the rulemaking procedures prescribed by <ref href="/us/usc/t5/s553">section 553 of title 5</ref>, to be used in committing rape or sexual assault.</content>
</clause>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I17" class="indent1 firstIndent0">The Attorney General is authorized to remove any substance from the list of date rape drugs pursuant to the same rulemaking authority.</continuation>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442abba-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><chapeau> The term “authorized purchaser” means any of the following persons, provided such person has acquired the controlled substance in accordance with this chapter:</chapeau><clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abbb-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/B/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> A person with a valid prescription that is issued for a legitimate medical purpose in the usual course of professional practice that is based upon a qualifying medical relationship by a practitioner registered by the Attorney General. A “qualifying medical relationship” means a medical relationship that exists when the practitioner has conducted at least 1 medical evaluation with the authorized purchaser in the physical presence of the practitioner, without regard to whether portions of the evaluation are conducted by other heath <ref class="footnoteRef" idref="fn002147">1</ref><note type="footnote" id="fn002147"><num>1</num> So in original. Probably should be “health”.</note> professionals. The preceding sentence shall not be construed to imply that 1 medical evaluation demonstrates that a prescription has been issued for a legitimate medical purpose within the usual course of professional practice.</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abbc-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/B/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><content> Any practitioner or other registrant who is otherwise authorized by their registration to dispense, procure, purchase, manufacture, transfer, distribute, import, or export the substance under this chapter.</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abbd-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/2/B/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><content> A person or entity providing documentation that establishes the name, address, and business of the person or entity and which provides a legitimate purpose for using any “date rape drug” for which a prescription is not required.</content>
</clause>
</subparagraph>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2442abbe-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/g/3"><num value="3">(3)</num><content> The Attorney General is authorized to promulgate regulations for record-keeping and reporting by persons handling 1,4–butanediol in order to implement and enforce the provisions of this section. Any record or report required by such regulations shall be considered a record or report required under this chapter.</content>
</paragraph>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abbf-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h"><num value="h" class="bold">(h)</num><heading class="bold"> Offenses involving dispensing of controlled substances by means of the Internet</heading><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abc0-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/1"><num value="1" class="bold">(1)</num><heading class="bold"> In general</heading><chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">It shall be unlawful for any person to knowingly or intentionally—</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abc1-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/1/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><content> deliver, distribute, or dispense a controlled substance by means of the Internet, except as authorized by this subchapter; or</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abc2-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/1/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><content> aid or abet (as such terms are used in <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s2">section 2 of title 18</ref>) any activity described in subparagraph (A) that is not authorized by this subchapter.</content>
</subparagraph>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abc3-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/2"><num value="2" class="bold">(2)</num><heading class="bold"> Examples</heading><chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Examples of activities that violate paragraph (1) include, but are not limited to, knowingly or intentionally—</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abc4-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/2/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><content> delivering, distributing, or dispensing a controlled substance by means of the Internet by an online pharmacy that is not validly registered with a modification authorizing such activity as required by <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s823/g">section 823(g) of this title</ref> (unless exempt from such registration);</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abc5-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/2/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><content> writing a prescription for a controlled substance for the purpose of delivery, distribution, or dispensation by means of the Internet in violation of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s829/e">section 829(e) of this title</ref>;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abc6-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/2/C"><num value="C">(C)</num><content> serving as an agent, intermediary, or other entity that causes the Internet to be used to bring together a buyer and seller to engage in the dispensing of a controlled substance in a manner not authorized by sections <ref class="footnoteRef" idref="fn002148">2</ref><note type="footnote" id="fn002148"><num>2</num> So in original. Probably should be “section”.</note> 823(g) or 829(e) of this title;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abc7-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/2/D"><num value="D">(D)</num><content> offering to fill a prescription for a controlled substance based solely on a consumer’s completion of an online medical questionnaire; and</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abc8-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/2/E"><num value="E">(E)</num><content> making a material false, fictitious, or fraudulent statement or representation in a notification or declaration under subsection (d) or (e), respectively, of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s831">section 831 of this title</ref>.</content>
</subparagraph>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abc9-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/3"><num value="3" class="bold">(3)</num><heading class="bold"> Inapplicability</heading><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2442abca-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/3/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><chapeau> This subsection does not apply to—</chapeau><clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abcb-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/3/A/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> the delivery, distribution, or dispensation of controlled substances by nonpractitioners to the extent authorized by their registration under this subchapter;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abcc-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/3/A/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><content> the placement on the Internet of material that merely advocates the use of a controlled substance or includes pricing information without attempting to propose or facilitate an actual transaction involving a controlled substance; or</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2442abcd-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/3/A/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><chapeau> except as provided in subparagraph (B), any activity that is limited to—</chapeau><subclause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id2442abce-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/3/A/iii/I"><num value="I">(I)</num><content> the provision of a telecommunications service, or of an Internet access service or Internet information location tool (as those terms are defined in <ref href="/us/usc/t47/s231">section 231 of title 47</ref>); or</content>
</subclause>
<subclause style="-uslm-lc:I14" class="indent3" id="id2442abcf-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/3/A/iii/II"><num value="II">(II)</num><content> the transmission, storage, retrieval, hosting, formatting, or translation (or any combination thereof) of a communication, without selection or alteration of the content of the communication, except that deletion of a particular communication or material made by another person in a manner consistent with <ref href="/us/usc/t47/s230/c">section 230(c) of title 47</ref> shall not constitute such selection or alteration of the content of the communication.</content>
</subclause>
</clause>
</subparagraph>

<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I79" class="indent3 firstIndent-2" id="id2442abd1-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s841/h/4"><num value="4" class="bold">(4)</num><heading class="bold"> Knowing or intentional violation</heading><content><p style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1">Any person who knowingly or intentionally violates this subsection shall be sentenced in accordance with subsection (b).</p>
</content>
</paragraph>

<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(1) possesses any piperidine with intent to manufacture phencyclidine except as authorized by this subchapter, or</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(2) possesses any piperidine knowing, or having reasonable cause to believe, that the piperidine will be used to manufacture phencyclidine except as authorized by this subchapter,</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I33" class="indent0 firstIndent0">shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 5 years, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $250,000 if the defendant is an individual or $1,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both.”</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsecs. (f), (g). <ref href="/us/pl/100/690/s6055/b">Pub. L. 100–690, § 6055(b)</ref>, added subsecs. (f) and (g).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">1986—<ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1005/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1005(a)</ref>, amended <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s224/a">Pub. L. 98–473, § 224(a)</ref>. See 1984 Amendment note below.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1103/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1103(a)</ref>, substituted “, 845a, or 845b” for “or 845a” in introductory provisions.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(1)(A). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1002/2">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1002(2)</ref>, amended subpar. (A) generally. Prior to amendment, subpar. (A) read as follows: “In the case of a violation of subsection (a) of this section involving—</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(i) 100 grams or more of a controlled substance in schedule I or II which is a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of a narcotic drug other than a narcotic drug consisting of—</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I23" class="indent2">“(I) coca leaves;</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I23" class="indent2">“(II) a compound, manufacture, salt, derivative, or preparation of coca leaves; or</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I23" class="indent2">“(III) a substance chemically identical thereto;</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(ii) a kilogram or more of any other controlled substance in schedule I or II which is a narcotic drug;</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(iii) 500 grams or more of phencyclidine (PCP); or</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(iv) 5 grams or more of lysergic acid di­ethylamide (LSD);</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I33" class="indent0 firstIndent0">such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 20 years, a fine of not more than $250,000, or both. If any person commits such a violation after one or more prior convictions of him for an offense punishable under this paragraph, or for a felony under any other provision of this subchapter or subchapter II of this chapter or other law of a State, the United States, or a foreign country relating to narcotic drugs, marihuana, or depressant or stimulant substances, have become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 40 years, a fine of not more than $500,000, or both”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(1)(B). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1002/2">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1002(2)</ref>, amended subpar. (B) generally. Prior to amendment, subpar. (B) read as follows: “In the case of a controlled substance in schedule I or II except as provided in subparagraphs (A) and (C),, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 15 years, a fine of not more than $125,000, or both. If any person commits such a violation after one or more prior convictions of him for an offense punishable under this paragraph, or for a felony under any other provision of this subchapter or subchapter II of this chapter or other law of a State, the United States, or a foreign country relating to narcotic drugs, marihuana, or depressant or stimulant substances, have become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 30 years, a fine of not more than $250,000, or both. Any sentence imposing a term of imprisonment under this paragraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a special parole term of at least 3 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a special parole term of at least 6 years in addition to such term of imprisonment.”</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(1)(C). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1002/2">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1002(2)</ref>, added subpar. (C). Former subpar. (C) redesignated (D).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(1)(D). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1004/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1004(a)</ref>, substituted “term of supervised release” for “special parole term” in two places.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ref href="/us/pl/99/570">Pub. L. 99–570</ref>, §§ 1002(1), 1003(a)(1), redesignated former subpar. (C) as (D), substituted “a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $250,000 if the defendant is an individual or $1,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual” for “a fine of not more than $50,000” and “a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $500,000 if the defendant is an individual or $2,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual” for “a fine of not more than $100,000”, and inserted “except in the case of 100 or more marihuana plants regardless of weight,”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(2). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1004/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1004(a)</ref>, substituted “term of supervised release” for “special parole term” in two places.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1003/a/2">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1003(a)(2)</ref>, substituted “a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $250,000 if the defendant is an individual or $1,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual” for “a fine of not more than $25,000” and “a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $500,000 if the defendant is an individual or $2,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual” for “a fine of not more than $50,000”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(3). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1003/a/3">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1003(a)(3)</ref>, substituted “a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $100,000 if the defendant is an individual or $250,000 if the defendant is other than an individual” for “a fine of not more than $10,000” and “a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $200,000 if the defendant is an individual or $500,000 if the defendant is other than an individual” for “a fine of not more than $20,000”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(4). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1003/a/4">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1003(a)(4)</ref>, which directed the substitution of “1(D)” for “1(C)” was executed by substituting “(1)(D)” for “(1)(C)” as the probable intent of Congress.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(5). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1003/a/5">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1003(a)(5)</ref>, amended par. (5) generally. Prior to amendment, par. (5) read as follows: “Notwithstanding paragraph (1), any person who violates subsection (a) of this section by cultivating a controlled substance on Federal property shall be fined not more than—</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(A) $500,000 if such person is an individual; and</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I22" class="indent1">“(B) $1,000,000 if such person is not an individual.”</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (c). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1004/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1004(a)</ref>, substituted “term of supervised release” for “special parole term” wherever appearing, effective <date date="1987-11-01">Nov. 1, 1987</date>, the effective date of the repeal of subsec. (c) by <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s224/a/2">Pub. L. 98–473, § 224(a)(2)</ref>. See 1984 Amendment note below.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1103/b">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1103(b)</ref>, substituted “, 845a, or 845b” for “845a” in two places.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (d). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1003/a/6">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1003(a)(6)</ref>, substituted “a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $250,000 if the defendant is an individual or $1,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual” for “a fine of not more than $15,000”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (e). <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s15005">Pub. L. 99–570, § 15005</ref>, added subsec. (e).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">1984—Subsec. (b). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s503/b/1">Pub. L. 98–473, § 503(b)(1)</ref>, inserted reference to <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s845a">section 845a of this title</ref> in provisions preceding par. (1)(A).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s224/a/1">Pub. L. 98–473, § 224(a)(1)</ref>–(3), (5), which directed amendment of this subsection effective <date date="1987-11-01">Nov. 1, 1987</date> (see <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s235/a/1">section 235(a)(1) of Pub. L. 98–473</ref> set out as an Effective Date note under <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3551">section 3551 of Title 18</ref>, Crimes and Criminal Procedure) was repealed by <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1005/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1005(a)</ref>, and the remaining pars. (4) and (6) of <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s224/a">Pub. L. 98–473, § 224(a)</ref>, were redesignated as pars. (1) and (2), respectively.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(1)(A). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/1/A">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(1)(A)</ref>, added subpar. (A). Former subpar. (A) redesignated (B).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(1)(B). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/1/A">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(1)(A)</ref>, (B), redesignated former subpar. (A) as (B), substituted “except as provided in subparagraphs (A) and (C),” for “which is a narcotic drug”, “$125,000” for “$25,000”, and “$250,000” for “$50,000”, and inserted references to laws of a State and a foreign country. Former subpar. (B) redesignated (C).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(1)(C). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/1/A">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(1)(A)</ref>, (C), redesignated former subpar. (B) as (C), substituted “less than 50 kilograms of marihuana, 10 kilograms of hashish, or one kilogram of hashish oil” for “a controlled substance in schedule I or II which is not a narcotic drug”, “and (5)” for “, (5), and (6)”, “$50,000” for “$15,000”, and “$100,000” for “$30,000”, and inserted references to laws of a State and a foreign country.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(2). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/2">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(2)</ref>, substituted “$25,000” for “$10,000” and “$50,000” for “$20,000”, and inserted references to laws of a State or of a foreign country.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(3). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/3">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(3)</ref>, substituted “$10,000” for “$5,000” and “$20,000” for “$10,000”, and inserted references to laws of a State or of a foreign country.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(4). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/4">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(4)</ref>, substituted “(1)(C)” for “(1)(B)”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s224/a/1">Pub. L. 98–473, § 224(a)(1)</ref>, as renumbered by <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1005/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1005(a)</ref>, substituted “in <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s844">section 844 of this title</ref> and <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3607">section 3607 of title 18</ref>” for “in subsections (a) and (b) of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s844">section 844 of this title</ref>”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(5). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/5">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(5)</ref>, (6), added par. (5) and struck out former par. (5) which related to penalties for manufacturing, etc., phencyclidine.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(6). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s502/5">Pub. L. 98–473, § 502(5)</ref>, struck out par. (6) which related to penalties for violations involving a quantity of marihuana exceeding 1,000 pounds.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (c). <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s224/a/2">Pub. L. 98–473, § 224(a)(2)</ref>, as renumbered by <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/s1005/a">Pub. L. 99–570, § 1005(a)</ref>, struck out subsec. (c) which read as follows: “A special parole term imposed under this section or section 845, 845a, or 845b of this title may be revoked if its terms and conditions are violated. In such circumstances the original term of imprisonment shall be increased by the period of the special parole term and the resulting new term of imprisonment shall not be diminished by the time which was spent on special parole. A person whose special parole term has been revoked may be required to serve all or part of the remainder of the new term of imprisonment. A special parole term provided for in this section or section 845, 845a, or 845b of this title shall be in addition to, and not in lieu of, any other parole provided for by law.”</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ref href="/us/pl/98/473/s503/b/2">Pub. L. 98–473, § 503(b)(2)</ref>, inserted reference to <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s845a">section 845a of this title</ref> in two places.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">1980—Subsec. (b)(1)(B). <ref href="/us/pl/96/359/s8/c/1">Pub. L. 96–359, § 8(c)(1)</ref>, inserted reference to par. (6) of this subsection.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(6). <ref href="/us/pl/96/359/s8/c/2">Pub. L. 96–359, § 8(c)(2)</ref>, added par. (6).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">1978—Subsec. (b)(1)(B). <ref href="/us/pl/95/633/s201/1">Pub. L. 95–633, § 201(1)</ref>, inserted “, except as provided in paragraphs (4) and (5) of this subsection,” after “such person shall”.</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (b)(5). <ref href="/us/pl/95/633/s201/2">Pub. L. 95–633, § 201(2)</ref>, added par. (5).</p>
<p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Subsec. (d). <ref href="/us/pl/95/633/s201/3">Pub. L. 95–633, § 201(3)</ref>, added subsec. (d).</p>
</note>

<note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="effectiveDateOfAmendment" id="id2442abd8-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b"><heading class="centered smallCaps">Effective Date of 2018 Amendment</heading><p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Amendment by <ref href="/us/pl/115/391">Pub. <note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="effectiveDateOfAmendment" id="id2442abdd-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b"><heading class="centered smallCaps">Effective Date of 1978 Amendment</heading><p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0">Amendment by <ref href="/us/pl/95/633">Pub. <note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="repeals" id="id2442abdf-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b"><heading class="centered smallCaps">Repeals</heading><p style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><ref href="/us/pl/96/359/s8/b">Pub. L. 96–359, § 8(b)</ref>, <date date="1980-09-26">Sept. 26, 1980</date>, <ref href="/us/stat/94/1194">94 Stat. 1194</ref>, repealed <ref href="/us/pl/95/633/s203/d">section 203(d) of Pub. L. 95–633</ref>, which had provided for the repeal of subsec. (d) of this section effective <date date="1981-01-01">Jan. 1, 1981</date>.</p>
</note>
<note style="-uslm-lc:I74" topic="miscellaneous" id="id2442abe0-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b"><heading class="centered smallCaps">Application of Fair Sentencing Act</heading><p><ref href="/us/pl/115/391/tIV/s404">Pub. L. 115–391, title IV, § 404</ref>, <date date="2018-12-21">Dec. 21, 2018</date>, <ref href="/us/stat/132/5222">132 Stat. 5222</ref>, provided that:<quotedContent origin="/us/pl/115/391/tIV/s404">
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><num value="a">“(a)</num><heading> <inline class="small-caps">Definition of Covered Offense</inline>.—</heading><content>In this section, the term ‘covered offense’ means a violation of a Federal criminal statute, the statutory penalties for which were modified by section 2 or 3 of the Fair Sentencing Act of 2010 (<ref href="/us/pl/111/220">Public Law 111–220</ref>; <ref href="/us/stat/124/2372">124 Stat. 2372</ref>) [amending this section and sections 844 and 960 of this title], that was committed before <date date="2010-08-03">August 3, 2010</date>.</content>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><num value="b">“(b)</num><heading> <inline class="small-caps">Defendants Previously Sentenced</inline>.—</heading><content>A court that imposed a sentence for a covered offense may, on motion of the defendant, the Director of the Bureau of Prisons, the attorney for the Government, or the court, impose a reduced sentence as if sections 2 and 3 of the Fair Sentencing Act of 2010 (<ref href="/us/pl/111/220">Public Law 111–220</ref>; <ref href="/us/stat/124/2372">124 Stat. 2372</ref>) were in effect at the time the covered offense was committed.</content>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I21" class="indent0"><num value="c">“(c)</num><heading> <inline class="small-caps">Limitations</inline>.—</heading><content>No court shall entertain a motion made under this section to reduce a sentence if the sentence was previously imposed or previously reduced in accordance with the amendments made by sections 2 and 3 of the Fair Sentencing Act of 2010 (<ref href="/us/pl/111/220">Public Law 111–220</ref>; <ref href="/us/stat/124/2372">124 Stat. 2372</ref>) or if a previous motion made under this section to reduce the sentence was, after the date of enactment of this Act [<date date="2018-12-21">Dec. 21, 2018</date>], denied after a complete review of the motion on the merits. Nothing in this section shall be construed to require a court to reduce any sentence pursuant to this section.”</content>
</subsection>
</quotedContent>
</p>
</note>
</notes>
</section>
