<section style="-uslm-lc:I80" id="id24510418-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960"><num value="960">§ 960.</num><heading> Prohibited acts A</heading><subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id24510419-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/a"><num value="a" class="bold">(a)</num><heading class="bold"> Unlawful acts</heading><chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">Any person who—</chapeau><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2451041a-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/a/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><content> contrary to section 825, 952, 953, or 957 of this title, knowingly or intentionally imports or exports a controlled substance,</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2451041b-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/a/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><content> contrary to <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s955">section 955 of this title</ref>, knowingly or intentionally brings or possesses on board a vessel, aircraft, or vehicle a controlled substance, or</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2451041c-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/a/3"><num value="3">(3)</num><content> contrary to <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s959">section 959 of this title</ref>, manufactures, possesses with intent to distribute, or distributes a controlled substance,</content>
</paragraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">shall be punished as provided in subsection (b).</continuation>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2451041d-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b"><num value="b" class="bold">(b)</num><heading class="bold"> Penalties</heading><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2451041e-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><chapeau> In the case of a violation of subsection (a) of this section involving—</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2451041f-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><content> 1 kilogram or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of heroin;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24510420-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><chapeau> 5 kilograms or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of—</chapeau><clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24510421-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/B/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> coca leaves, except coca leaves and extracts of coca leaves from which cocaine, ecgonine, and derivatives of ecgonine or their salts have been removed;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24510422-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/B/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><content> cocaine, its salts, optical and geometric isomers, and salts or isomers;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24510423-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/B/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><content> ecgonine, its derivatives, their salts, isomers, and salts of isomers; or</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24510424-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/B/iv"><num value="iv">(iv)</num><content> any compound, mixture, or preparation which contains any quantity of any of the substances referred to in clauses (i) through (iii);</content>
</clause>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24510425-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/C"><num value="C">(C)</num><content> 280 grams or more of a mixture or substance described in subparagraph (B) which contains cocaine base;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24510426-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/D"><num value="D">(D)</num><content> 100 grams or more of phencyclidine (PCP) or 1 kilogram or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of phencyclidine (PCP);</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24510427-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/E"><num value="E">(E)</num><content> 10 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD);</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24510428-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/F"><num value="F">(F)</num><content> 400 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of N-phenyl-N- [1- ( 2-phenylethyl ) -4-piperidinyl] propanamide or 100 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of any analogue of N-phenyl-N-[1-(2-phenylethyl)-4-piperidinyl] propanamide;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537529-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/G"><num value="G">(G)</num><content> 1000 kilograms or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of marihuana; or</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2453752a-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/1/H"><num value="H">(H)</num><content> 50 grams or more of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, and salts of its isomers or 500 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, or salts of its isomers.<ref class="footnoteRef" idref="fn002170">1</ref><note type="footnote" id="fn002170"><num>1</num> So in original. The period probably should be a semicolon.</note></content>
</subparagraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">the person committing such violation shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 10 years and not more than life and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 20 years and not more than life, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $10,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $50,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a serious drug felony or serious violent felony has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 15 years and not more than life imprisonment and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to life imprisonment, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $20,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $75,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Notwithstanding <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3583">section 3583 of title 18</ref>, any sentence under this paragraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 5 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 10 years in addition to such term of imprisonment. Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the court shall not place on probation or suspend the sentence of any person sentenced under this paragraph. No person sentenced under this paragraph shall be eligible for parole during the term of imprisonment imposed therein.</continuation>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2453752b-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><chapeau> In the case of a violation of subsection (a) of this section involving—</chapeau><subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2453752c-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/A"><num value="A">(A)</num><content> 100 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of heroin;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2453752d-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/B"><num value="B">(B)</num><chapeau> 500 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of—</chapeau><clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2453752e-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/B/i"><num value="i">(i)</num><content> coca leaves, except coca leaves and extracts of coca leaves from which cocaine, ecgonine, and derivatives of ecgonine or their salts have been removed;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id2453752f-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/B/ii"><num value="ii">(ii)</num><content> cocaine, its salts, optical and geometric isomers, and salts or isomers;</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24537530-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/B/iii"><num value="iii">(iii)</num><content> ecgonine, its derivatives, their salts, isomers, and salts of isomers; or</content>
</clause>
<clause style="-uslm-lc:I13" class="indent2" id="id24537531-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/B/iv"><num value="iv">(iv)</num><content> any compound, mixture, or preparation which contains any quantity of any of the substances referred to in clauses (i) through (iii);</content>
</clause>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537532-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/C"><num value="C">(C)</num><content> 28 grams or more of a mixture or substance described in subparagraph (B) which contains cocaine base;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537533-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/D"><num value="D">(D)</num><content> 10 grams or more of phencyclidine (PCP) or 100 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of phencyclidine (PCP);</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537534-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/E"><num value="E">(E)</num><content> 1 gram or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD);</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537535-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/F"><num value="F">(F)</num><content> 40 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of N-phenyl-N- [1- ( 2-phenylethyl ) -4-piperidinyl] propanamide or 10 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of any analogue of N-phenyl-N-[1-(2-phenylethyl)-4-piperidinyl] propanamide;</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537536-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/G"><num value="G">(G)</num><content> 100 kilograms or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of marihuana; or</content>
</subparagraph>
<subparagraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537537-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/2/H"><num value="H">(H)</num><content> 5 grams or more of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, and salts of its isomers or 50 grams or more of a mixture or substance containing a detectable amount of methamphetamine, its salts, isomers, or salts of its isomers.<sup>1</sup></content>
</subparagraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">the person committing such violation shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 5 years and not more than 40 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than twenty years and not more than life, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $5,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $25,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a serious drug felony or serious violent felony has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than 10 years and not more than life imprisonment and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to life imprisonment, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $8,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $50,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Notwithstanding <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3583">section 3583 of title 18</ref>, any sentence imposed under this paragraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, include a term of supervised release of at least 4 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, include a term of supervised release of at least 8 years in addition to such term of imprisonment. Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the court shall not place on probation or suspend the sentence of any person sentenced under this paragraph. No person sentenced under this paragraph shall be eligible for parole during the term of imprisonment imposed therein.</continuation>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id24537538-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/3"><num value="3">(3)</num><content> In the case of a violation under subsection (a) of this section involving a controlled substance in schedule I or II, gamma hydroxybutyric acid (including when scheduled as an approved drug product for purposes of section 3(a)(1)(B) of the Hillory J. Farias and Samantha Reid Date-Rape Drug Prohibition Act of 2000), or flunitrazepam, the person committing such violation shall, except as provided in paragraphs (1), (2), and (4), be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 20 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not less than twenty years and not more than life, a fine not to exceed the greater of that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $1,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $5,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. If any person commits such a violation after a prior conviction for a felony drug offense has become final, such person shall be sentenced to a term of imprisonment of not more than 30 years and if death or serious bodily injury results from the use of such substance shall be sentenced to life imprisonment, a fine not to exceed the greater of twice that authorized in accordance with the provisions of title 18 or $2,000,000 if the defendant is an individual or $10,000,000 if the defendant is other than an individual, or both. Notwithstanding <ref href="/us/usc/t18/s3583">section 3583 of title 18</ref>, any sentence imposing a term of imprisonment under this paragraph shall, in the absence of such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 3 years in addition to such term of imprisonment and shall, if there was such a prior conviction, impose a term of supervised release of at least 6 years in addition to such term of imprisonment. Notwithstanding the prior sentence, and notwithstanding any other provision of law, the court shall not place on probation or suspend the sentence of any person sentenced under the provisions of this paragraph which provide for a mandatory term of imprisonment if death or serious bodily injury results.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id24537539-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/4"><num value="4">(4)</num><content> In the case of a violation under subsection (a) with respect to less than 50 kilograms of marihuana, except in the case of 100 or more marihuana plants regardless of weight, less than 10 kilograms of hashish, or less than one kilogram of hashish oil, the person committing such violation shall be sentenced in accordance with <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1/D">section 841(b)(1)(D) of this title</ref>.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2453753a-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/5"><num value="5">(5)</num><content> In the case of a violation of subsection (a) involving a controlled substance in schedule III, such person shall be sentenced in accordance with <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/1">section 841(b)(1) of this title</ref>.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2453753b-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/6"><num value="6">(6)</num><content> In the case of a violation of subsection (a) involving a controlled substance in schedule IV, such person shall be sentenced in accordance with <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/2">section 841(b)(2) of this title</ref>.</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0" id="id2453753c-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/b/7"><num value="7">(7)</num><content> In the case of a violation of subsection (a) involving a controlled substance in schedule V, such person shall be sentenced in accordance with <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s841/b/3">section 841(b)(3) of this title</ref>.</content>
</paragraph>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2453753d-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/c"><num value="c" class="bold">(c)</num><heading class="bold"> Repealed. <ref href="/us/pl/98/473/tII/s225">Pub. L. 98–473, title II, § 225</ref>, formerly § 225(a), <date date="1984-10-12">Oct. 12, 1984</date>, <ref href="/us/stat/98/2030">98 Stat. 2030</ref>, as amended by <ref href="/us/pl/99/570/tI/s1005/c">Pub. L. 99–570, title I, § 1005(c)</ref>, <date date="1986-10-27">Oct. 27, 1986</date>, <ref href="/us/stat/100/3207-6">100 Stat. 3207–6</ref></heading><content/>
</subsection>
<subsection style="-uslm-lc:I19" class="indent2 firstIndent-2" id="id2453753e-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d"><num value="d" class="bold">(d)</num><heading class="bold"> Penalty for importation or exportation</heading><chapeau style="-uslm-lc:I11" class="indent0">A person who knowingly or intentionally—</chapeau><paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id2453753f-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d/1"><num value="1">(1)</num><content> imports or exports a listed chemical with intent to manufacture a controlled substance in violation of this subchapter or subchapter I;</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537540-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d/2"><num value="2">(2)</num><content> exports a listed chemical in violation of the laws of the country to which the chemical is exported or serves as a broker or trader for an international transaction involving a listed chemical, if the transaction is in violation of the laws of the country to which the chemical is exported;</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537541-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d/3"><num value="3">(3)</num><content> imports or exports a listed chemical knowing, or having reasonable cause to believe, that the chemical will be used to manufacture a controlled substance in violation of this subchapter or subchapter I;</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537542-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d/4"><num value="4">(4)</num><content> exports a listed chemical, or serves as a broker or trader for an international transaction involving a listed chemical, knowing, or having reasonable cause to believe, that the chemical will be used to manufacture a controlled substance in violation of the laws of the country to which the chemical is exported;</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537543-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d/5"><num value="5">(5)</num><content> imports or exports a listed chemical, with the intent to evade the reporting or recordkeeping requirements of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s971">section 971 of this title</ref> applicable to such importation or exportation by falsely representing to the Attorney General that the importation or exportation qualifies for a waiver of the 15-day notification requirement granted pursuant to paragraph (2) or (3) of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s971/f">section 971(f) of this title</ref> by misrepresenting the actual country of final destination of the listed chemical or the actual listed chemical being imported or exported;</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537544-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d/6"><num value="6">(6)</num><content> imports a listed chemical in violation of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s952">section 952 of this title</ref>, imports or exports such a chemical in violation of section 957 or 971 of this title, or transfers such a chemical in violation of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s971/d">section 971(d) of this title</ref>; or</content>
</paragraph>
<paragraph style="-uslm-lc:I12" class="indent1" id="id24537545-d2b4-11ef-aec8-fd2c8883213b" identifier="/us/usc/t21/s960/d/7"><num value="7">(7)</num><content> manufactures, possesses with intent to distribute, or distributes a listed chemical in violation of <ref href="/us/usc/t21/s959">section 959 of this title</ref>.<ref class="footnoteRef" idref="fn002171">2</ref><note type="footnote" id="fn002171"><num>2</num> So in original. The period probably should be a comma.</note></content>
</paragraph>

<continuation style="-uslm-lc:I10" class="indent0 firstIndent0">shall be fined in accordance with title 18, imprisoned not more than 20 years in the case of a violation of paragraph (1) or (3) involving a list I chemical or not more than 10 years in the case of a violation of this subsection other than a violation of paragraph (1) or (3) involving a list I chemical, or both.</continuation>
</subsection>
